title: Artabanus of Media
summary: Raleigh names Artabanus of Media in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Artabanus, in Diodorus his list of the Median Kings, who raigned fortie yeeres. He is not the Egyptian Artabanus of seuen moneths. The one-word title would fold onto artabanus, so the title is three words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
